home.title: Gartic
home.description: Gartic is a real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game. Each round, one player receives a secret word and draws it on the shared canvas; the rest try to guess by typing in the chat. The faster you guess, the more points you earn — and the drawer scores for every correct guess too. At the end of all rounds, the player with the most points wins.
home.aboutText: We are the ft_transcendence team from 42 Porto: Renan (resilva), Pedro (pebarbos), Thiago (thevaris) and Carlos (carlos-j). This site is an academic project built for learning purposes.

rules.title: Game Rules
rules.rule1: Each room needs at least 3 players to start.
rules.rule2: Each round, every player draws exactly once; the others guess.
rules.rule3: The drawer receives 3 words and picks 1.
rules.rule4: Drawing has an 80-second time limit (configurable per room).
rules.rule5: Guesses are typed in the dedicated field; wrong guesses appear in the room chat.
rules.rule6: Faster correct guesses earn more points; the drawer earns points for every correct guess.
rules.rule7: The round ends when time runs out or everyone has guessed; the word is then revealed.
rules.rule8: The player with the most points at the end of all rounds wins.
rules.rule9: Inactive players or those with off-topic drawings can be reported: first offence is a warning; repeat offenders are removed from the room.
rules.rule10: If a player disconnects and doesn't return in time, their turn is skipped and the game continues.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.disclaimer: Example document with a fictional company, for academic purposes (ft_transcendence, 42 Porto). Last updated: 4 August 2026.
privacy.s1Body: Gartic is operated by Garatuja Games, Lda. (fictional company), Rua da Imaginação 42, 4000-000 Porto, Portugal. Privacy contact: privacidade@garatuja.example.
privacy.s2i2: Password stored only as a hash (bcrypt) — never in plain text;
privacy.s2i4: Game statistics: rank, total points, games played, and wins;
privacy.s3Body: Authentication and session management, game functionality (scoreboard, leaderboard, friends system), and essential account communications. We do not sell or share data with third parties.
privacy.s4Body: We use only essential cookies: a session cookie (httpOnly) to maintain your login. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies.
privacy.s5Body: Data is stored in our database for as long as the account exists. All communication between browser and server is HTTPS.
privacy.s6Body: You can access, correct, or delete your data (including deleting your account) via your profile or by contacting privacidade@garatuja.example.
privacy.s7Body: Chat messages exist only during the game session and are not stored in the database.
